scope: Descriptive Train only. S1/S2 all historical Train characters, S3 first 12 calibration characters; never use last-six validation characters or Test
covariance: Per retained 0-800ms epoch, temporal channel demeaning and ddof=1 covariance in uV^2; arithmetic mean across epochs in session
distance: Frobenius norm of difference of symmetric matrix logs, divided by sqrt(16); also export unnormalized distance
small_distance_interpretation: 2*log(1.1), equivalent to 10% uniform amplitude gain if covariance differs only by uniform gain; operational engineering threshold, not a universal norm
all_small_rule: All three pairs S1-S2, S1-S3, S2-S3 are at or below the small threshold for every subject
amplitude: Per epoch/channel signed temporal mean, mean absolute voltage and RMS; summarize session mean and epoch quartiles; no label conditioning
plots: Ten subjects in 2x5 panels, shared y scale, fixed session colors; IQR shows distribution across overlapping epochs, not a confidence interval
follow_up: No EA in this run. Report drift only, then user decides whether an EA comparison is warranted. Do not change main experiment.
